title: Magic is coming to Netflix: the week in cards
intro: One free email every Sunday with the week in cards. Here's the latest issue as a magazine: tap the cover to open it, and sign up free at the bottom of the page.
opening: Zia and Luna here with Issue 03. Magic just landed a Netflix series, Riftbound swung the ban hammer, Star Trek boarded Magic, and Pikachu got his own birthday box.
image_alt: Luna reports: Magic's Planeswalker series comes to Netflix in 2027

cover.sub: Planeswalker puts Chandra on screen in 2027

pull: Finally, a reason to binge-watch that counts as deck research.

stories.title: Magic's Planeswalker series comes to Netflix in 2027
stories.summary: Netflix revealed PLANESWALKER on November 13, 2026: an animated Magic: The Gathering series centered on Chandra, premiering in 2027.
stories.quip: Finally, a reason to binge-watch that counts as deck research.

facts: Netflix and Wizards of the Coast revealed PLANESWALKER, an animated series based on Magic: The Gathering, on November 13, 2026.
The series premieres on Netflix in 2027.
The story centers on Chandra, a volatile pyromancer hunted for her gifts, alongside some of the most legendary Planeswalkers.
Terry Matalas is showrunner, Cindy Appel co-showrunner and Patrick Osborne supervising director.
Animation is by the studio Digic, with Hasbro Entertainment among the producers.
details.why: Magic's first big streaming series puts Chandra and the Planeswalkers in front of a whole new audience.

stories.title: Riftbound bans Riven, Dazzling Aurora and more
stories.summary: Riftbound's Radiance ban list adds eight cards and two battlefields to Standard and 2v2 Constructed, effective Monday, November 23, 2026.
stories.quip: Riven players, it's time to find a new main.

facts: Announced November 13, 2026; the bans take effect Monday, November 23, 2026, in Standard and 2v2 Constructed.
Eight cards are banned: Riven, Broken Blade; Zhonya's Hourglass; Stellacorn Herder; Nocturne, Horrifying; Rhasa the Sunderer; Brynhir Thundersong; Dazzling Aurora; and Baited Hook.
Two battlefields are banned too: Emperor's Dais and Star Spring.
Riven made up 43% of decks at the European Regional Championship and took 3 of the top 4 spots.
Korea and Traditional Chinese regions aren't affected until Radiance releases there; from 2027, bans come in set windows around each Continental.
details.why: Riven, Kennen and Kai'Sa decks all lose key cards, so the competitive meta resets before December's North America Regional Championship.

stories.title: Magic's Star Trek is out; To Boldly Go league starts
stories.summary: Magic: The Gathering | Star Trek releases November 13, 2026, and the To Boldly Go sealed league runs in stores through January 28, 2027.
stories.quip: Six boosters, four quadrants, one promotion to Captain. Engage.

facts: Magic: The Gathering | Star Trek is in stores today, November 13, 2026.
To Boldly Go is a Sealed league at WPN stores, running November 13, 2026 to January 28, 2027.
Players start with six Star Trek Play Boosters and can add more boosters as they rank up.
Play three games at Starfleet Academy, then explore four quadrants (Alpha, Beta, Gamma and Delta), each with its own rules.
Every three matches in a quadrant earns a rank pip; reaching Captain earns a league promo card.
details.why: It's a casual, months-long way to play the new set at your local store, with a promo at the end.

stories.title: Pokémon Day 2027 Collection lands January 29
stories.summary: The Pokémon Day 2027 Collection reaches stores January 29, 2027, with a stamped foil Pikachu promo, three booster packs, a coin and a TCG Live code card.
stories.quip: Pikachu's birthday party comes with its own party favors.

facts: Pokémon Day 2027 Collection releases January 29, 2027 (The Pokémon Company International).
It includes a specially stamped foil Pikachu promo card.
Also inside: three Pokémon TCG booster packs and a collectible coin.
A code card for Pokémon TCG Live comes in the box.
Pokémon Day itself is February 27, 2027.
details.why: A new stamped Pikachu promo is a yearly collector favourite, and it lands a month before Pokémon Day.

stories.title: Fang wins Flesh and Blood Worlds in Paris
stories.summary: Nicolas Jamoulle won World Championship: Paris (November 5-8, 2026) on Fang, Dracai of Blades; runner-up Jin Han Toh also played Fang.
stories.quip: Paris had one dragon on top, and another right behind it.

stories.title: Flesh and Blood's 2027 season: three $200K Pro Tours
stories.summary: The 2027 World Tour brings three $200,000 Pro Tours, one Global Leaderboard and a $10,000 Player of the Year crowned in Kobe; Pro Quests start February 13, 2027.
stories.quip: Three Pro Tours, zero excuses to skip practice.

stories.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!'s Magnificent Maestros lands this Friday
stories.summary: Konami's 125-card set hits stores November 13, 2026, with 18 reimagined anime cards that also come as Grand Master Rares, serial-numbered 001 to 100.
stories.quip: One hundred copies. Please stop checking your binder.

stories.title: Magic's Rise of the Polygons Secret Lair goes retro
stories.summary: Wizards' polygon-era Secret Lair, with Balefire Dragon and Young Pyromancer, sells November 16-30, 2026, with half the sale price going to Extra Life.
stories.quip: Low poly, high charity, maximum dragon.

stories.title: My Little Pony TCG's The Coronation lands Feb 19
stories.summary: Kayou's fifth English My Little Pony TCG booster set, The Coronation, reaches retail February 19, 2027, with new mechanics Leap In, Revelation and Triumph.
stories.quip: Friendship is magic. Pulling the chase card is luck.
